changes: Allow user follow-up questions, comparisons, explanations, next-step requests and short confirmations; preserve conversation language and empty abstentions.
Default history completion, paused inline completion and right-arrow word acceptance to off; preserve Tab-to-draft and manual Enter submission.
Hide completed-turn suggestions for nonempty drafts and dismiss the current session/turn with Escape.
Use current settings revisions with one bounded retry; refresh subscriptions when a delayed session binding becomes ready.
Abort stale prediction on the next turn start and remove previous suggestions before the next prediction.
Include session/turn identity in render keys and reattach the overlay after editor replacement.
Exclude injected rule, skill, runtime and time messages from prediction transcripts so real user intent and language survive the budget.
Read live options from authoritative settings documents after UI changes and dispose root settings listeners with the plugin.
Rebuild host/browser artifacts and add focused filter, runtime, client and host regression tests.
Use DSH-Input Prediction as the display name through exported locale metadata; retain the original technical package, settings, event and cache identities for existing installations.
Reject suggestion URLs not copied exactly from user messages, independently of model approval.
Require grounded intent evidence and reject unsupported concrete values, paths, accounts and model identifiers.

Merged upstream v0.6.0: robust settings/ops pipeline (CAS writes, deferred pushes, fault signatures), completion-answer gate, language-detection and inject-filter fixes; kept grounding checks, intent gate, JSON protocol, relaxed Chinese filters and disabled-by-default auxiliary modes.
verification_scope: Build, seven upstream smoke groups and Chinese suggestion regression tests; live DSH installation and model verification are recorded separately.

branding.compatibility: The technical package name, entry id, settings namespace, projection, events and browser storage keys are preserved so an existing installation can be updated in place.
